ceu: ✦ The conjunction between the Sun and Mercury

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on your career and your goals. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. This is where your strength lies today.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on relationships and partnerships. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.

The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on routine, daily work and health. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on home and family. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on your money and what you value. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on your image and your personal energy. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Join a group or a conversation about a subject you enjoy.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on rest and your inner life. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
s.d: Show your work: people who do not show up are not remembered.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:9}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on friends and plans for the future. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Listen to a podcast or a talk on a new subject.
